text:
```yaml
name: Repomix

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  repomix:
    name: Repomix
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Repomix
        uses: yamadashy/repomix-action@main
        with:
          output: repomix-output.txt
          compression: true

      - name: Upload Repomix Output
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: repomix-output
          path: repomix-output.txt
          retention-days: 30
```
